tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The bidders need to register with KPPP portal and to obtain User ID and Password for participating in KPPP Portal.
Interested bidders can get the information through the following web portal: https://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
The tenders are liable for rejection if any of the above said requirements are not complied with.
The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his/her tender, and the purchaser will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the tender Processing is not being refundable.
The University does not bind itself to accept the lowest bidder and the university reserves the right to Accept or Reject any of the tender or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
The authority reserves the Right to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
IMP: FINANCIAL BID WILL BE OPENED AFTER COMPLETE EVALUATION OF THE TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS
Bidder has to gothrough the Tender Document indetail before bidding for the detailed terms and conditions.
For any clarification tenderer may contact Mr. Raghavendra. Mobile No.7411389527 (Only during office hours).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Government University / Government Institution: The Bidder must have a minimum of 3 years continuous experience in providing manpower outsourcing services to a Government University/Government Higher Educational Institution.

Government University Work Done Certificate: The Bidder must possess a valid Work Done/Satisfactory Performance Certificate confirming successful execution of the manpower outsourcing contract involving minimum 50 personnel for a continuous period of 3 years.

Security Services Experience: The Bidder must have experience in providing security personnel/services to Government Institutions, Universities, PSUs, Government Departments or other reputed organisations.

Minimum security Deployment: The Bidder must have provided and managed a minimum of 50 employees continuously under contract for the above Government University/Government Institution for the past 3 years. The manpower shall include Staff, Workers and Security Personnel, as applicable.
Contract Labour Manpower Strength: The Bidder must have documentary evidence of having deployed/managed a minimum of 50 contract employees.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- relevant statutory record showing 50 employees, along with supporting manpower records wherever applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Security Services Licence: Since Security Services are included in the manpower requirement, the Bidder must possess a valid PSARA Licence for Karnataka and should have held such licence continuously for a minimum period of 10 years preceding the date of submission of the bid.

Continuous Statutory Compliance: The Bidder must have a minimum of 5 years of continuous statutory compliance track record with timely payment/deposit of applicable PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) and other applicable statutory contributions.

PF & ESIC Compliance: The Bidder must demonstrate that PF and ESIC contributions relating to its employees/contract manpower have been regularly deposited within the prescribed statutory timelines for the preceding 5 years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- EPFO ECRs, PF challans, ESIC contribution records and payment challans for the relevant period.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Professional Tax & LWF Compliance: The Bidder must demonstrate continuous compliance with applicable Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund requirements for the preceding 5 years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PT and LWF registration/returns/payment challans and other supporting records.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ISO Certification: The Bidder must be an ISO-certified company/organisation having a valid ISO certification relevant to its service activities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid ISO Certificate issued by an accredited/recognised certification body

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Managing Multiple Categories of Manpower: The Bidder must have demonstrated experience in managing Staff, Workers and Security Personnel under manpower outsourcing/service contracts

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Work Orders, Agreements and Work Done/Satisfactory Performance Certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover: The Bidder must have achieved a minimum annual turnover of Rs5 Crore (Rupees Five Crore only) in each of the last three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST Authority Certified Turnover Mandatory- For the purpose of establishing financial capacity, turnover shall be supported by an Annual Turnover Certificate issued/certified by the GST Commissioner/GST Authority. A self-declaration or turnover statement alone shall not be accepted as proof of turnover.
Financial & Legal Standing: The Bidder must not be under liquidation, insolvency, receivership or similar proceedings as on the date of submission of the bid.

Karnataka Presence: The Bidder must have a registered/operational office in Karnataka and adequate administrative infrastructure to manage manpower deployment, payroll and statutory compliance within Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration, Shops & Establishments Registration, office address proof and other applicable registration documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Non-Blacklisting: The Bidder must not have been blacklisted/debarred by any Central Government/State Government Department, Government University, PSU, Autonomous Body or statutory authority as on the date of submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration/Affidavit as prescribed in the tender document.
